    TRUE (),
    SELECTEDVALUE ( RepairOrderDetail[Aging] ) = "1 - 7 Days",
        CALCULATE (

            FILTER (
                RepairOrderDetail,

            )
        ),

            DISTINCTCOUNT ( RepairOrderDetail[RONumber] ),

                RepairOrderDetail,
                RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceLastLabor] >= 8
                    && RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceLastLabor] <= 14
            )
        ),
    SELECTEDVALUE ( RepairOrderDetail[Aging] ) = "15 - 30 Days",

            DISTINCTCOUNT ( RepairOrderDetail[RONumber] ),
            FILTER (
                RepairOrderDetail,
                RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceLastLabor] >= 15
                    && RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceLastLabor] <= 30
            )
        ),
    SELECTEDVALUE ( RepairOrderDetail[Aging] ) = "31 - 60 Days",

            DISTINCTCOUNT ( RepairOrderDetail[RONumber] ),
            FILTER (
                RepairOrderDetail,
                RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceLastLabor] >= 31
                    && RepairOrderDetail[DaysSinceLastLabor] <= 60
            )
        ),
    SELECTEDVALUE ( RepairOrderDetail[Aging] ) = "60+ Days",

            FILTER (
                RepairOrderDetail,
